en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a busy waterfront street scene in front of a large brick railway station building. Sailing ships with tall masts are docked beside the station, while people, horse‑drawn carts, and an early tram or streetcar occupy the foreground. The architecture is 19th‑century, with arched windows and a clock tower. Printed caption text appears below the image.
